en.body:
Night City is back, and with it, a fresh wave of desperate souls navigating its chrome-plated chaos. **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2** has finally landed on Netflix, expanding the gritty universe with new characters and their intertwined fates. Among the newcomers is Omi, a nomadic survivor whose story is brought to life by the talented **Analesa Fisher** (they/them). However, Fisher's path to voicing Omi wasn't the straightforward gig one might expect.

## A Different Role, A Different Call

When the call came to audition for **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2**, Fisher initially set their sights on a different character entirely: Yupi, the blonde, upbeat personality. "I had auditioned for Yupi, the blonde character, and I wanted her so bad," Fisher shared in an interview. "I was like, 'Oh, she's crazy, she's so cool, and she's super upbeat.'" Despite the strong desire for that role, Fisher didn't get it. But as fate would have it, the universe had other plans. "Then I didn't get it, which was fine. And then a week later, I went to visit my family in Portland. I was literally at my brother's house, playing with his children. I got a text from my best friend, Valeria Rodriguez, who voices Roman in the show. And she goes, 'Can I call you?' And I knew..."

This unexpected turn led Fisher to the role of Omi, a character whose journey promises to be as compelling as any in the original series. **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2** plunges viewers back into the neon-drenched metropolis, following the struggles of Weak, a cybernetically-challenged legend seeking purpose, and the vengeful nomad D. Across ten standalone episodes, the season explores themes of family, obsession, and legacy, emphasizing how our perceptions shape the stories around us. Fisher's extensive voice acting background, including work on **Monster High**, **Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir**, and games like **Honkai: Star Rail**, undoubtedly prepared them for the emotional depth required for Omi.

## What This Means for Night City Fans

For fans of **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners**, the introduction of new, fully realized characters like Omi is precisely what keeps the world of Night City alive and breathing. The series, which premiered worldwide on Netflix on October 20, 2026, has consistently delivered character-driven narratives that resonate deeply with its audience. Fisher's personal connection to the casting process, from initial disappointment to a surprising second chance, mirrors the themes of resilience and unexpected paths that define the **Cyberpunk** universe itself. It’s a testament to the vibrant, often unpredictable nature of this world, proving that sometimes, the best roles are the ones you weren't initially looking for. The passionate fanbase eagerly anticipates how Omi will carve out their space in this brutal, yet captivating, future.

## What's Next

With **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2** now available for binge-watching on Netflix, fans can fully immerse themselves in the latest tales from Night City. Further details regarding potential future seasons or spin-offs have not yet been announced.
